subject: HIPAA onboarding: ops fee vs. credit split proposal
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@mediocorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: MediOCorp Procurement <procurement@mediocorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — onboarding ops fee + HIPAA package

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. We loved the latency profiles and the auditlog preview you showed. As we head into procurement, two questions came up we need to resolve before our procurement/legal teams greenlight the PO:

1) Onboarding ops fee: your standard approach lists a $30k onboarding/implementation fee vs. a credit model applied across the first 12 months. Can you share an example split (how much upfront vs. monthly credit) and any precedent for amortizing that fee over the contract?

2) HIPAA bundle vs. ala carte: we need to understand where KMS/HSM seats and extended audit-retention live in the pricing—do those come as a single "HIPAA bundle" creditable against the onboarding fee, or are they billed as recurring add-ons? If recurring, what are the unit economics (per-seat vs. throughput) and a typical uplift we should expect in year 1?

We're trying to keep the PO process simple (single recurring line item preferred) but we also must show CIO-level cost transparency. Procurement looped in on cc.

Appreciate any sample workback or SOW you can share — also happy to hop on a 30-min call.

Thanks,
Linda
Linda Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
MediOCorp Health

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@mediocorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — onboarding ops fee + HIPAA package

Hi Linda — really glad the demo resonated. Quick answers and I'll attach a short workback.

1) Onboarding ops fee vs. crediting: our common path for enterprise HIPAA pilots is to offer a $25k onboarding implementation fee, with the option to convert up to 60% of that into monthly service credits spread across the first 12 months. Example: $25k fee -> $15k credit across 12 months = $1,250/mo credit. The remaining $10k covers migration/offboarding and proofing work that we typically invoice up front or net-30. We can also amortize the full $25k across the first 12 months if you'd prefer the PO to show one smoothing line.

2) Packaging: we treat KMS seats and HSM access as recurring add-ons (per-seat annualized for HSM; per-seat/month for KMS depending on managed vs. customer-hosted). Audit log retention beyond the standard 90 days is a storage/ingest uplift (billed per GB/mo). For clarity: we can offer a "HIPAA compliance bundle" that bundles 3 HSM seats + extended audit retention (1TB/yr) and SLA proofs into a single monthly line item with a negotiated discount. If you want one recurring line on the PO, bundle is the cleanest route.

I've attached a one-page workback (HIPAA_Onboard_Workback.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_Draft_v1.pdf). Ben — can you confirm fiscal treatment and any margin constraints if we convert onboarding fee to credits? Karthik — could you provide the KMS/HSM unit price ranges so Linda's procurement team has numbers to run?

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HIPAA_Onboard_Workback.xlsx, SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Linda Park <linda@mediocorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — onboarding ops fee + HIPAA package

Thanks Marissa — quick finance perspective.

Marissa's breakdown is the right commercial play for procurement simplicity. A few clarifications:
- If we convert onboarding to monthly credits we need a minimum 12-month committed spend to avoid revenue recognition complexity (we've used 12 months historically).
- From a margin standpoint: converting 60% of the onboarding fee into credits is acceptable on standard pilots; beyond 60% requires approval from RevOps.
- Unit prices (ballpark to include on the PO): KMS managed seat $150/user/month; HSM access (dedicated slot) $8,000/seat/year (includes basic onboarding). Extended audit retention: $0.08/GB/month for cold-tier; hot-tier retention is $0.25/GB/month. We can create a blended SKU if you want a single recurring line.

If procurement wants the billing to be one recurring line, we typically draft a bundle SKU (example: "HIPAA-Base-Bundle") that represents the blended cost and maps to our internal metering for usage reporting. That makes invoicing + chargeback easier for corporate accounting.

Karthik, if you have more precise HSM procurement lead-times (hardware provisioning / attestation window), flag that here.

-Ben
Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Linda Park <linda@mediocorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: MediOCorp Procurement <procurement@mediocorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — onboarding ops fee + HIPAA package

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick follow-ups and the workback. Procurement reviewed the numbers and draft SOW. A few asks before we route the PO:

1) Please send a single-line bundled monthly SKU for the HIPAA package that includes: 3 HSM seats (annualized), 3 managed KMS seats, and 1TB/year extended audit retention. We prefer a blended monthly number that our AP team can code easily.

2) For the onboarding fee, MediOCorp accepts converting 50% of the $25k to monthly credits over 12 months (i.e., $12,500 -> $1,041.67/mo). The remaining $12,500 should be invoiced as a one-time implementation charge payable net-30.

3) Please confirm HSM provisioning lead-time and whether attestation docs (FIPS cert / provisioning checklist) will be delivered before customer acceptance. We need the attestation for our internal security signoff.

If you can produce the bundled SKU and a DocuSign-ready exhibit (we'll attach our PO_5678.pdf), we can get legal/procurement to sign in the next 3 business days. Thanks — looping procurement so they can follow up on invoice terms.

Best,
Linda Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
MediOCorp Health

Attachments: PO_5678.pdf
